statement: Restricted to the parameter space of smooth S4-symmetric cubic forms, the 27-line cover has Klein four monodromy. Its orbits comprise six pairs, three quadruples, and three fixed lines.

answer.text: C2 × C2 on the S4-symmetric parameter subfamily
answer.qualification: Restricted symmetric coefficient space, not the unrestricted cubic family. The quotient-orbifold monodromy in Theorem 1.2 is S4 × K4.

group.description: Klein four-group C2 x C2; nontransitive action on the 27 lines in the S4-symmetric coefficient family

source.location: Theorem 1.3; Corollary 5.13; Appendix A, Data A.3–A.4

scope: Smooth cubic surfaces defined by homogeneous polynomials symmetric under permutations of four coordinates.
notes: The LMFDB link identifies the abstract group; this 27-point action is not transitive. Generators were obtained exactly by taking the centralizer of Data A.3 inside the order-16 group generated by Data A.4, as Theorem 1.3 identifies it. Exact enumeration confirms order 4 and orbit sizes 1,1,1,2,2,2,2,2,2,4,4,4. This avoids transcription inconsistencies in Data A.5. Do not replace the generic W(E6) headline with this restricted result.
